title: Baby Dino
hook: 一只蓝色恐龙宝宝在找妈妈，得送它去恐龙岛。

cells.en: “Is it a baby cow?” No, it is a baby dinosaur! It lost its mamá.
cells.cn: “这是小牛吗？”不是，是一只恐龙宝宝——它找不到妈妈了。

cells.en: “I know where Baby Dino's mommy is — at Dino Island.”
cells.cn: “我知道恐龙宝宝的妈妈在哪儿——在恐龙岛。”

cells.en: “These are little Compsognathus dinosaurs.” They are very small and fast.
cells.cn: “这些是小巧的腔骨龙。”它们又小又灵活。

cells.en: “Aw, Baby Dino picked a flower for his mommy.” What a sweet dinosaur!
cells.cn: “哇，恐龙宝宝给妈妈摘了一朵花。”真是只贴心的恐龙。

cells.en: “Will you help us tiptoe past the T. rex?” Shhh — walk softly!
cells.cn: “你能帮我们悄悄走过霸王龙吗？”嘘——脚步要轻！

cells.en: Dino Island is across the water. The big blue dinosaur looks at the sea.
cells.cn: 恐龙岛就在水对面，大蓝恐龙望着海面。

cells.en: “Mommy.” Baby Dino gives the yellow flower to his mother at last.
cells.cn: “妈妈。”恐龙宝宝终于把那朵黄花送到了妈妈手里。

cells.en: “We did it!” Dora and Boots dance with the dinosaur family.
cells.cn: “我们做到了！”Dora 和 Boots 跟恐龙一家一起跳舞。

cells.en: “Una, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete.” Seven stars for today!
cells.cn: “一、二、三、四、五、六、七。”今天得了七颗星！

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baby Dino”.
ending: In the end, Baby Dino finds his mommy on Dino Island. My favorite part is ______.
